verdict.rationale: Fivetran's own docs say transformations can run on a set schedule or automatically after connection syncs. Connectors sync data automatically, and the pricing page lists 1-minute syncs, which implies recurring sync jobs. However, there is no documentation of configuring sync frequency, schedule types, or managing schedules programmatically through the REST API or MCP server, which an AI-native user would need. Missing for 10: documented connector sync-frequency/schedule configuration, schedule management via API/MCP for agent-driven workflows, general workflow scheduling beyond transformations, independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduling behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Transformations are automatically executed after connection syncs or on a set schedule.
Fivetran provides pre-built data connectors that automatically sync data from your applications, databases, event streams, and files to your data warehouse or data lake.
